message: Multiple request properties resolve to the same generated name "plantId" after camelCase normalization: path parameter "plant_id" (SDK name "plant_id"), requestBody property "plantId" (SDK name "plantId") inherited via allOf from "PlantKey". This causes broken generated code. Use x-fern-parameter-name on a parameter or x-fern-property-name on a requestBody property to disambiguate.
